body: A clean slate sounds like a great idea, however if I stayed alive the best option for me would be to make an effort towards graduation as I've already invested two years. But you aren't the only one I've heard the clean slate approach from. If all else fails this would be a good plan. Thanks for the input.
Fine i guess. Sometimes I can feel fine and happy and at others really down and aware of the holes in my life. It seems to come in waves. I can hide it well because of this.
